page.title: Phone and voice
page.description: Phone numbers your agents answer, outbound calls and LiveKit rooms. Calls use the same tools, rules and memory as the chat.

button.open: Talk to the agent by voice
button.label: Voice
button.title: Voice call · {agent}
button.description: Talk to the agent from your browser. Every turn is in Traces with its latency and cost.
button.hangupDescription: The call is still live. Closing the panel hangs up.

call.modeTextHint: Your browser transcribes and speaks (Web Speech API)
call.demoTitle: Demo mode: your browser does the voice
call.demoBody: No speech providers are configured (DEEPGRAM_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY), so your browser transcribes and speaks. The agent, its tools, rules and memory are the same.
call.intro: Press start and speak normally. You can interrupt the agent at any time.
call.consent: I consent to this call being recorded and the recording being stored.
call.approvalBody: The agent needs an approval to continue.
call.latencyHint: From the end of your speech to the agent's first audio
call.typeInsteadNoMic: Your browser can't transcribe speech: type your message
call.errorTitle: The call could not be made

errors.micDenied: We don't have permission to use the microphone. Allow it in your browser and try again.
errors.audioUnsupported: This browser can't capture or play audio.
errors.speechUnsupported: This browser can't recognize speech. Try Chrome or Edge, or type your messages.
errors.connectionLost: Couldn't connect to the voice service. Please try again.
errors.invalidTicket: The voice session expired. Start the call again.
errors.server: The voice service couldn't take the call.

calls.emptyDescription: Voice and phone calls will show up here with their transcript, latency and cost.

detail.noRecordingText: Demo mode calls are not recorded: the audio never leaves the browser.
detail.audioUnsupported: Your browser can't play the recording.
detail.deleteRecordingDescription: The audio file is deleted for good. The transcript and traces are kept.

dictation.micDenied: We don't have permission to use the microphone

settings.enabledHint: Lets the agent answer by phone, in the browser and in LiveKit rooms.
settings.demoBody: Without speech providers the browser transcribes and speaks. For phone and real audio configure DEEPGRAM_API_KEY and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.
settings.voiceBrowserHint: In demo mode the voices installed in the browser are used.
settings.voicesError: The provider's voices couldn't be loaded.
settings.greetingHint: The first thing the agent says when the call starts. Leave it empty to wait for the user to speak.
settings.greetingPlaceholder: Hi, I'm Acme's assistant. How can I help you?

phone.setupBody: To assign numbers and take calls, add your Twilio or Telnyx credentials to the voice service:
phone.setupWebhooks: Messer configures each number's voice webhook when you assign it (Twilio: /telephony/twilio/voice; Telnyx: Call Control application → /telephony/telnyx/webhook).
phone.needsAudioBody: Phone calls can't use the browser's voice: configure DEEPGRAM_API_KEY and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (or OPENAI_API_KEY).
phone.numbersDescription: Each number is answered by an agent of the project.
phone.emptyDescription: Buy a number or assign one from your account so an agent answers its calls.
phone.emptySetup: Once Twilio or Telnyx is configured you can assign numbers here.
phone.environmentHint: Production answers with the deployed version; development with the latest saved version.
phone.assignDescription: Assign a number from your provider account or buy a new one. Messer configures its voice webhook.
phone.sourceBuyHint: Bought in your provider account and billed there.
phone.noOwned: There are no free numbers in the account.
phone.noAvailable: No numbers available with those criteria.
phone.label: Label
phone.greetingHint: Replaces the agent's greeting on this number. Optional.
phone.recordCallsHint: At the start the agent announces that the call is recorded.
phone.invalidNumber: Write the number in international format (+44…)
phone.callGreetingHint: What the agent says when they pick up. Optional.
phone.noCalls: Calls to and from your numbers will show up here.
phone.removeDescription: The number will stop answering calls in this project.
phone.releaseToo: Also release the number at {provider} (stops billing and can't be undone)

livekit.title: LiveKit rooms
livekit.description: The agent joins a room and any LiveKit client can talk to it.
livekit.setupBody: Add LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET to create rooms with your agents.
livekit.needsAudioBody: Configure DEEPGRAM_API_KEY and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (or OPENAI_API_KEY) to use rooms.
livekit.tokenHint: The token expires in one hour and only grants access to this room.
